name: Nozomi Kanaetamae -Who Dreamed It?-
original_name: ノゾミカナエタマエ -Who Dreamed It?-
source:
There is a book in the second-hand bookstore that can make all dreams come true. It opens way to a magnificent world full of mysteries and wonderful beings.
Three girls turn over the page with this world and become part of it. Black cat on the snow guides them into this fleeting dream. But this world needs protection as monster whispers in the center of this place.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
二手书店里有一本能够实现所有愿望的书。它打开通往宏伟世界的道路，那里充满神秘与奇妙生灵。

三名女孩翻开描绘这个世界的书页，成为其中的一部分。雪地里的黑猫引导她们进入短暂的梦境。然而，这个世界需要保护，因为某种怪物正在中心低语。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
